items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: This is Millard Lacy... When the business began to get rough a lot of my friends over there, your father and Lacy and Woodman and all of them... I was solo trumpet player in that group for a number of years.

ctx.x: No, we had two bands at that time. This is Millard Lacy.
